open_decision: Whether the command may append a duplicate copy of a row that is already in the registry, because the laws constrain a new row only when it is not equal to an old row.
result_a: [{id:1,adapter:1,model:1,enabled:true}] (ref: nothing is absent, so nothing is added)
result_b: [{id:1,adapter:1,model:1,enabled:true},{id:1,adapter:1,model:1,enabled:true}] (design B appends a copy of the existing row)
reason: AddsOnlyAbsent and NoSameIdentity apply only to new rows x with x not in r, so a copy of an old row escapes them. No starter is absent, so the other laws are vacuous. NewInStarterOrder passes because new ids [1] are a sublist of starter ids [1].
